messages:
mira: opened a short PR to consolidate guidance on streaming failures, resume cursors, and context-trim interactions. includes tiny python/node snippets and a micro repro harness (mock server) for CI. PTAL :wave:

jon: drop the link? want to check the wording for mid-stream 429 vs sync 429 and the recommended client behavior.

mira: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1001. I added a small section 'Interpreting mid-stream errors' and a one-paragraph matrix mapping observable codes to likely causes.

kevin: paste the matrix here so I can copy to the SDK quickstart. would help ops.

mira: copied from PR: "Matrix: sync 429 = request rejected (backoff); mid-stream 429/trailer = service overload, honor Retry-After or resume later; abrupt connection close/502/504 = upstream failure; client cancel/proxy cancel = client-side abort (499)."

jon: nice. two actionable asks: 1) show a minimal resume pattern that avoids double-counting tokens, 2) add a Dedicated vs Hosted note about queueing vs immediate 429s.

mira: added a tiny idempotent-tail + cursor snippet and a short 'Deployment differences' bullet linking to dedicated capacity docs. snippet: ```python
# pseudo-resume pattern
resp = client.stream(prompt, headers={"x-resume-cursor": cursor})
for ev in resp:
  if ev.cursor <= last_committed:
    continue
  out += ev.text
  last_committed = ev.cursor
```

kevin: ops question: what do we recommend when servers trim prefix due to context limit? customers get confused when resumed output misses earlier context.

mira: added guidance: checkpoint application-level commit points (message IDs or turn IDs) rather than raw token offsets; use idempotent prompt suffixes for safety. small example added.

selena: editorial: wrap headers like `Retry-After` and `x-resume-cursor` in code spans, and add a :warning: about billing for duplicated tokens.

mira: done both. also added a short migration blurb: "Disable implicit SDK auto-reconnect for streams or provide an explicit resume API to the application."

docs-bot: CI checks started for PR #1001  link: https://ci.internal.redwood/1501.

jon: LGTM from tech review. leaving final wording to selena.

selena: light copy edits, tightened a couple sentences. merge after CI. :shipit:

docs-bot: PR #1001 merged by selena at 1901012390.
